_about: 351 Watch Virginia test (2026-10): 37 Southside and Piedmont counties (Board of Supervisors, Planning Commission, BZA) plus key towns (energy_siting_hotspots.md areas 2 and 9). Same row shape as towns_ma_all.json plus state, kind, selection_group / selection_reason / selection_source. Built by `python3 experiments/mi_va_test.py discover --state VA`.
gate_note: Test state: not part of the production daily run. Crawled only by `python3 -m watch351.daily --states MI,VA --output-dir ../data/test --hits-name hits_mi_va.json`.
evidence_rule: a board is automated only if its listing shows >=1 agenda/packet/notice dated within [today-120d, today+120d] and the first such document is fetchable under robots.txt
